name: CE 5210
title: Environmental Engineering Chemistry - I
description: (Also offered as ENVE 5210.) Quantitative treatment of chemical behavior in environmental systems. Thermodynamics and kinetics of acid/base, complexation, precipitation/dissolution, sorption and redox reactions; degradation and partitioning of organic contaminants; software for speciation and partitioning computation.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
